text: Janto kadi an Nulaaɗo, ñalnde Alla immintinoyta e kala mofte Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on ko seeditoo e gomɗinal gomɗinooɗo maɓɓe on e keeferaaku yeddunooɗo maɓɓe on. Refti heeferɓe ɓen sakki- tantaake ngantinagol e ko ɓe wonunoo e keefeeru kon, wanaa kamaɓe woni ruttiteteeɓe aduna fii gollugol ko welata Joomi maɓɓe, tawde laakara ko galle hasboore, wanaa galle golle.
